briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA, 17 November 2026

**Purpose:** Background for a meeting on 17 November 2026. Covers the last 30 days (about 18 Oct to 17 Nov). Every fact below is drawn from the search results and cited.

## Leadership change (dominant story)

- **Huang departure:** NVIDIA's board announced that Jensen Huang has left all his positions with immediate effect after 33 years as CEO. Longtime CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO. (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline; https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- **Interim structure:** Kress remains CFO until a successor is chosen. The board has started a search and will consider internal and external candidates. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- **Shift in board messaging:** An 8 November board statement said the board "has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team." (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors) Four days later, the CEO change was announced.
- **Reported reasons (unconfirmed):** The WSJ reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that the board was preparing to oust Huang after two extramarital affairs, one reportedly with a suspected Chinese spy. (https://www.wsj.com/business/nvidia-is-preparing-to-oust-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-30f421ad) A Wired headline, carried by Mezha, says NVIDIA hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair. The results contain only the headline, not the article. (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired)
- **Independent directors:** A separate statement from the independent board members was issued 10 November. The results show only its title. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)

## Launches and deals

- **AWS capacity plan:** An AWS and NVIDIA announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027 and 2028. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)
- **Rubin:** Vera Rubin NVL72 debuted in MLPerf Inference v6.1 results in September 2026. Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in H2 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)
- **Sovereign AI:** NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion, dated 8 November. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)

## Hires

- No hiring news from the last 30 days appears in the results. The CEO search is the only leadership-hiring item, and no candidate has been named.

## Earnings timing

- NVIDIA is scheduled to release Q3 results around 4:20 p.m. ET on Tuesday, 17 November, with a call at 5 p.m. ET. It is the first call since Huang's exit. (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline)

## Caveats

- Older M&A entries in the results (Hugging Face, Aug 2026; Kumo.AI, Jun 2026; Illumex, Feb 2026; Groq, Dec 2025) fall outside the 30-day window and are omitted. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t)
- The WSJ and Wired reports are unconfirmed. Treat the personal-conduct details as reported claims, not established facts.

## Open questions

1. **Leadership:** What is the board's timeline and selection process for a permanent CEO, and will Kress remain CFO while also serving as interim CEO?
2. **Guidance and governance:** Given the 8 November expression of confidence followed by the 12 November departure, what changes to board oversight or disclosure should we expect, and will tonight's Q3 results or call include any change to outlook under interim leadership?
3. **Roadmap and capacity:** Has the leadership change affected the Rubin production ramp or the AWS 2027–2028 GPU deployment plan?
